bibl.title: Codices des Typs C und die Anfänge des Blätterns.
bibl.seg: Andrea Jördens, Codices des Typs C und die Anfänge des Blätterns.

Anna Krauss, Jonas Leipziger & Friederike Schücking-Jungblut (edd.), Material Aspects of Reading in Ancient and Medieval Cultures. Materiality, Presence and Performance = Materiale Textkulturen. 26 (Berlin - Boston, 2020) pp. 115-148, figg.
bibl.note: Presents multiple evidence for the so called "type C-codex", which consists of single sheets of papyrus or parchment, being joined to some kind of "loose-leaf collection", and examines the different types of bookbinding, namely by double holes, which can already be found in the 3rd cent. BCE in the context of ancient wooden or wax tablets. The results may also question the often-ascribed role of the Christian community in the emergence and implementation of the codex. - Appendices: Beispiele von Holz- und Wachstafeln bzw. -tafelensembles mit Doppellöchern (ohne die Evidenz der Oasen).
